engine.meaning: Verbatim apart from spelling ("authorisation", "Travelling"), so every rule survives.
engine.sense: No Aussie terms beyond spelling, and those are correct.
engine.authenticity: Correct Australian spelling, but no Australian voice at all. A US policy page as written.
engine.register: Untranslated except for spelling, well short of level 2.

unharnessed.meaning: Every rule survives accurately, including the 12-hour TDY rule, departure time zone, 26 pay periods and forfeiture.
unharnessed.sense: Plain-English swaps all fit: "getting to and from work", "runs out", "took off and landed", "work out".
unharnessed.authenticity: Natural Australian workplace English, though with little that is specifically Aussie: "Have a look at", "check out", "get in touch".
unharnessed.register: A very light touch, closer to level 1 than 2. It is mostly a plain-English rewrite with Australian spelling and only mild colloquialisms.
unharnessed.tone: The clear HR policy tone is kept.
unharnessed.variety: Little slang to vary. "work out" appears three times.

yarn.meaning: All rules survive. "so use it or lose it" is colour on the forfeiture rule. "There's no cap on earning" is accurate.
yarn.sense: Terms fit: "Have a squiz", "the nitty-gritty", "sing out to your Timekeeper", "spot on", "given the okay".
yarn.authenticity: Sounds like an Australian HR page with a friendly voice: "If you've got questions, sing out to your Timekeeper".
yarn.register: A light level-2 touch, with clear rules and a handful of idioms. No swearing.
yarn.tone: Friendly but still authoritative. "gone for good, so use it or lose it" keeps the warning firm.
yarn.flow: Smooth: "When you left the airport at the other end and got to your hotel".
yarn.variety: Varied: squiz, nitty-gritty, sing out, spot on, use it or lose it. "work out" appears twice.
yarn.essence: Clearly the policy page, retold lightly.

engine.quote: You may request travel comp time when you are approved to travel for work
engine.original: You may request travel comp time when you are approved to travel for work
engine.why: Left untranslated. Representative of the whole text, which ignores the level-2 brief.

unharnessed.original: to determine the breakdown of your hours

summaries.unharnessed: An accurate plain-English localisation, a touch light for level 2.
summaries.yarn: An accurate, natural, well-weighted level-2 localisation.
